description:
What setup pins for a protected deployment.

Setup copies these values into the anchor. Take them from the developer's install
guide, not from the control plane.

components.description: `ecdsa-p256:<base64 SPKI>` key that signs enforcer and component builds.

deployment.description: This deployment's ID, which every deployment-bound statement must name.

project.description: Project whose signed statements the deployment accepts.

sessionApproval.description: Who approves exec and debug sessions.

signing.description: `SHA256:<64 hex>` fingerprint of the developer's signer list version 1.
